messages:
Jordan: Heads-up: promotion blocked. staging-e2e failing on auth refresh (401) since 18:02 UTC. Logs show x-cache-status=HIT and x-cache-ttl=-1.

Sam: paste the failing assert? short, please. :eyes:

Jordan: ```
FAIL tests/e2e/test_refresh.py::test_refresh_token_rotation
E AssertionError: expected 200 but got 401
E Resp headers: {"x-cache-status":"HIT", "x-cache-ttl":"-1"}
```

Kira: -1 TTL looks like our fixture cache returned an expired payload after the token schema change. With CI cache off it passes.

deploy-bot: Promotion paused: failing check `staging-e2e` (job 6823456801). Auto-rollback policy: ENABLED (60s grace). Initiating automatic rollback to previous image sha256:99aabbcc.

Nadia: Wait, auto-rollback kicked in. We need to stop a full rollback if possible — team, can we hold the rollback and attempt eviction+re-run in the next 2m?

Sam: Auto-rollback already started; deploy-bot shows rollback in-progress. If rollback completes we can still re-promote manually but that will require change-window note.

Jordan: Rollback completed. Traffic back to sha256:99aabbcc. Canary is healthy.

Kira: Given the release window, rollback is safest. Proposal: accept rollback, mark release blocked, create hotfix branch to fix fixture-cache TTL behavior, and schedule a hotfix deploy by whitelist if we can get +2 approvals.

Nadia: Agreed. Decision: abort current promote, mark release as blocked-by-ci-cache, create ticket RD-8120 (auth fixture-cache TTL regression). We'll ship nothing until hotfix lands.

Sam: I'll open RD-8120 and add logs + commands. Also adding a temporary ops runbook step for manual eviction: `ci/tools/invalidate-fixtures --svc=auth-service --env=staging` so oncall can act faster.

ci-bot: RD-8120 created (https://issues.internal/RD-8120) assigned to Platform, priority P1, linked to job 6823456801.

Nadia: For release notes: include "Release held: auth-service reverted to previous image due to CI fixture cache TTL regression; patch planned (RD-8120)." Add to release-notes/draft.

Jordan: If Platform gets a hotfix PR ready quickly we can request an emergency promote; otherwise keep rollback and schedule unpin/unblock in next change window.

Sam: I'll start the hotfix branch now. Tagging Kira for cache TTL expert help.

Kira: On it. I'll also add a small CI guard to fail builds if `x-cache-ttl` < 0 in the response headers so this fails earlier next time.

Nadia: Thanks. Closing action items: RD-8120 owns fix, ops runbook updated, release notes updated, emergency promote path documented. Release remains blocked until hotfix or next window.

deploy-bot: Rollback completed earlier. Promotion remains paused. Notify when manual promote requested.
